7.1.1 Operation mode switching
A mode switch is requested with a call to the function CanTrcv_SetOpMode.
[SWS_CanTrcv_00161] ⌈A mode switch request to the current mode is allowed and
shall not lead to an error, even if DET is enabled.⌋
[SWS_CanTrcv_00158] ⌈The CanTrcv module shall invoke the callback func-
tion CanIf_TrcvModeIndication, for each mode switch request with call to
CanTrcv_SetOpMode, after the requested mode has been reached referring to the
corresponding CAN transceiver with the abstract CanIf TransceiverId.
See see [4,
